# HanziLookupJS (vendored)

Client-side Chinese / kanji handwriting recognition used by the Dictionary app's
handwriting pad. Loaded on demand from `/vendor/hanzilookup/` — not bundled.

- Source: https://github.com/gugray/HanziLookupJS (commit `b21124f`)
- `hanzilookup.min.js` — GNU GPL v3 (see `LICENSE`), derived from Jordan Kiang's HanziLookup.
- `mmah.json` — stroke data derived from Make Me a Hanzi `graphics.txt`
  (Arphic PL KaitiM GB / UKai), Arphic Public License (see `LICENSE-APL`).

Files are unmodified copies of `dist/` from the upstream repository.
